Smart Manufacturing
Transform your factory with intelligent automation. Our collaborative robotss, AMRs, and AI vision systems work alongside your workforce to increase productivity, quality, and flexibility.

Applications:
- Assembly & Kitting
- Quality Inspection
- Material Handling
- Machine Tending
- Packaging & Palletizing

Case study: A major electronics manufacturer deployed 12 CoBot C2 units and 8 CarryBot A1 AMRs across their PCB assembly line. Result: 40% throughput increase, 60% defect reduction, and ROI in 14 months.

metadata.title: Smart Manufacturing
metadata.keywords: Smart Manufacturing | Assembly & Kitting | Quality Inspection | Material Handling | Machine Tending | Packaging & Palletizing

text:
Smart Manufacturing — Assembly & Kitting
Collaborative robots handle repetitive assembly tasks with high precision, freeing human workers for higher-value activities. collaborative robots C2 and C5 models are ideal for electronics, automotive, and consumer goods assembly lines.

Smart Manufacturing — Quality Inspection
AI-powered vision systems automatically detect defects, measure dimensions, and verify assembly correctness at production-line speeds. Our computer vision models achieve 99.7%+ defect detection rates in electronics manufacturing.

Smart Manufacturing — Material Handling
CarryBot A1 AMRs autonomously transport raw materials, work-in-progress, and finished goods between production cells, warehouses, and shipping areas — eliminating manual forklift operations.

Smart Manufacturing — Machine Tending
collaborative robots arms load and unload CNC machines, injection molding presses, and test equipment 24/7. Quick changeover between product variants through teach-by-demonstration programming.

Smart Manufacturing — Packaging & Palletizing
End-of-line automation with collaborative robots C5 for case packing and palletizing. Handles mixed-SKU pallets with AI-powered stacking optimization.

Healthcare & Medical
Our healthcare robotics solutions improve hospital efficiency, reduce staff burden, and enhance patient care — from logistics automation to AI-assisted diagnostics.

Applications:
- Hospital Logistics
- Patient Assistance
- Disinfection
- Pharmacy Automation

metadata.title: Healthcare & Medical
metadata.keywords: Healthcare & Medical | Hospital Logistics | Patient Assistance | Disinfection | Pharmacy Automation

text:
Healthcare & Medical — Hospital Logistics
MediBot M1 automates medication delivery, lab sample transport, linen distribution, and meal delivery throughout hospital campuses. Integrates with HIS/EMR for automated task dispatching.

Healthcare & Medical — Patient Assistance
ServeBot S2 deployed in patient rooms and wards for non-clinical assistance — delivering water, adjusting lights, calling nurses, and providing entertainment.

Healthcare & Medical — Disinfection
UV-C equipped mobile robots autonomously disinfect patient rooms, operating theaters, and common areas. Validated 99.99% pathogen elimination.

Healthcare & Medical — Pharmacy Automation
CoBot arms handle medication picking, counting, and packaging in hospital pharmacies. Reduces medication errors and frees pharmacists for clinical duties.

Warehousing & Logistics
Automate your warehouse operations from receiving to shipping. Our AMRs and robotic systems handle goods movement, sorting, and order fulfillment with speed and accuracy.

Applications:
- Goods-to-Person Picking
- Cross-Docking & Sortation
- Inventory Management
- Last-Mile Delivery

metadata.title: Warehousing & Logistics
metadata.keywords: Warehousing & Logistics | Goods-to-Person Picking | Cross-Docking & Sortation | Inventory Management | Last-Mile Delivery

text:
Warehousing & Logistics — Goods-to-Person Picking
CarryBot AMRs bring inventory shelves to pick stations, eliminating worker walking time. Increases pick rates from 80 to 300+ lines per hour.

Warehousing & Logistics — Cross-Docking & Sortation
Autonomous robots sort incoming goods by destination at high speed. Reduces cross-dock processing time by 50%.

Warehousing & Logistics — Inventory Management
SkyBot I1 drones perform automated inventory counts in high-bay racking using barcode scanning and computer vision. Counts 10× faster than manual methods.

Warehousing & Logistics — Last-Mile Delivery
SkyBot D1 drones deliver small parcels within a 15 km radius. AutoHaul H1 autonomous vehicles handle larger deliveries on campus and between facilities.

metadata.title: Agriculture & Agritech
metadata.keywords: Agriculture & Agritech | Crop Monitoring | Autonomous Weeding & Spraying | Harvesting Assistance

text:
Agriculture & Agritech — Crop Monitoring
SkyBot I1 drones equipped with multispectral cameras survey crops, detecting disease, nutrient deficiency, and water stress before they become visible to the human eye.

Agriculture & Agritech — Autonomous Weeding & Spraying
Mobile robots with computer vision identify and remove weeds mechanically or apply targeted spraying — reducing herbicide use by up to 90%.

Agriculture & Agritech — Harvesting Assistance
CoBot arms with soft grippers and vision systems selectively harvest fruits and vegetables without damage. Adaptable to multiple crop types.
